text_block_list.text:
One day,
I was helping run a fan event for 
the academy students.
While managing the line for 
one of the main attractions,
a handshake event—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, my lovely principessa. 
Not a single day went by that I forgot that
smile... 
To see you again is like a dream!

text_block_list.name: Earth's fan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, Earth-sama remembered who I am...! 
Please let me record that right nooowww!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Please keep giving me lots of support! 
If you do...
I'll be able to work even harder♪

text_block_list.text:

Heh heh heh,

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this afternoon I shall shower you with
words of love. 
Even more passionately,
and even more fortissimo!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that really is your stance. 
Then I'll continue on with Operation 
'Fan-Favorite Royce-chan' as planned.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that your rhythm? 
If it were me,
I wouldn't be able to resist whispering
sweet nothings.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you really are that type,
aren't you? 
Earth's fans love that about you, too. 
Isn't that a wonderful win-win
relationship?

Their approaches may differ,
but both have gained 
tremendous popularity with the fans.
Which meansâ

text_block_list.text:
Indeed...
Both methods are great for gaining fans. 
If only we could combine them into one...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! Love will delve even deeper!
It's bound to become even more dolce!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Royce-san. May I borrow 
your beautiful expression of love?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
I was thinking the exact same thing. 
I'll be paying a visit to your field,
then.

The afternoon meet-and-greet is packed to
capacity, too. 
With Sounds of Earth making her entrance, 
the fans' excitement is boiling over!

text_block_list.name: Earth's fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah! Earth-sama~~~!
Please, say something, anything to us!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course... But, 
before that,
would you indulge a selfish request of
mine?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Will you play them for me... 
Your marcato words of love!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Whereas I...
am always the one receiving everyone's
support. 
So today, I want to give back to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Royce's fans
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, does that mean—wh-wh-what?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The love of my amores fills me. 
A fulfilled heart only gives birth to greater
love!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You've given me so much,
so here are my feelings— 
take every single bit!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let us spread it far and wide— 
An endless, immortal love!

text_block_list.name: Earth & Lois
text_block_list.text:
I want your love. 
I love every one of you♪

text_block_list.name: Fans of the two
text_block_list.text:
'Lady Earth gave me permission to love
her...! 
I'll stan her, I'll stan her for life!!' 
'This is Royce-chan's l-o-o-o-ve!'

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so this is the happiness of being
loved. 
Grazie, Royce-san...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the pleasure is mine. 
Everyone is thrilled...
It's simply perfect.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Loving or being loved, 
either way,
it's all about wanting to make the fans
happy.

To be loved,
or to love... which do you desire?

My wonderful, lovely amico♪

could you help me out again? 
It's very reassuring having you around.
